items.title: The doorman fallacy in the age of AI
items.raw_excerpt: A doorman just opens the door, right? Replace the doorman with an automatic sliding door and the door still opens plus we save some money. Great, but who greets the regulars, watches for trouble, or finds you a taxi in the rain? Rory Sutherland calls this the doorman fallacy : when we reduce a complex job to its most visible and automatable task, we miss the full scope of the role with all other intangible aspects.
